title: The number of Sylow subgroups and a generalization of Mersenne primes
summary: Fix an integer $m$ bigger than 2. We prove that if there exists a finite group with $mp+1$ Suylow $p$-subgroups, where $p$ is large enough, then $mp+1$ is prime. This improves on a theorem of M. Hall and is a partial answer to Brauer's Problem 26. Our proof uses techniques from analytic number theory, and it also raises new questions in that area.
